criterion_text: Direct P2P remains reconnectable while Server is down if a valid Agent Token is cached, and preserves existing Session stream/output cursor, controller lease and connection generation; token rejection/rotation follows bounded retry and clean re-fetch behavior without waiting for a P2P credential issuer, without a stale callback reopening closed sockets.

verifiers.summary: Direct P2P reconnects with the cached Agent Token while the Server is down, preserving stream and controller generation; rotation is refused cleanly and the current token is refetched after the Server returns

evidence.value: exact target SHA stack: with the Server stopped, a direct re-dial using the cached Agent Token re-served the Session with the same control generation; after a rotation the old token was refused and gained no authority; once the Server returned, one authenticated attach returned the rotated token and it authenticated the Agent
web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts keeps the Agent token in memory and refetches only through an authenticated attach after rejection or Server recovery
